turns.text: Hi, I need to change the delivery address. The parcel should not go to the address I used at checkout.
I can help with that. Please send me your order number (like SC-1234) and the email the order was placed with, and the new delivery address.
The order is SC-3360, the email is nora.blake@example.com, and the new address is Str. Exemplu 22, Sibiu.

Order SC-3360 has already shipped. The address can only be changed before shipping, so I can't change it myself. I've passed your request, with the new address Str. Exemplu 22, Sibiu, to a colleague. They will take over and decide.

rule.ro: Adresa de livrare se poate schimba până la expedierea comenzii. Schimbarea trebuie aprobată de echipă.
rule.en: The delivery address can change until the order ships. Staff must approve the change.

input.summary: Customer nora.blake@example.com (verified via SC-3360) asks to change delivery address to "Str. Exemplu 22, Sibiu". Policy says the order already shipped, so the change is not allowed automatically. A person must decide.
